comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.tale.0: ...and the bear was still wearing his boots when we found it.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.tale.1: My grandfather swam a river in flood with an ox on his back. So he said.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.tale.2: There's a hill north of here where the dead walk on moonless nights. I saw one. Didn't stay to ask its name.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.boast.0: Three of them, and me with a broken hand. They're the ones who ran.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.boast.1: Next raid, the first gold through the gate is mine.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.boast.2: I could fell a guard with this axe from across the river.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.joke.0: Why do town guards wear helmets? Nothing in there to protect.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.joke.1: The new one says they're cooking tonight. Who wants to dig the graves?
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.joke.2: A merchant offered me a fair price once. I've never laughed so hard.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.gripe.0: My boots have more holes than a sieve.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.gripe.1: Same stew, same faces, every night.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.gripe.2: Who took my good knife? I know one of you did.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.scoff.0: You? You'd trip over your own axe.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.scoff.1: That's not how I heard it.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.scoff.2: Sure. And I'm the chief's mother.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.rain.1: This rain'll have the fire out if it keeps on.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.song.0: ♪ Oh the road is long and the ale is thin... ♪
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.song.1: ♪ We took the town, we took the cow, we took the farmer's pig... ♪
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.song.2: ♪ Hey-ho, the fire's low, and none of us are sleeping... ♪
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.cook.0: Meat's on. Nobody touch it till I say.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.burnt.0: Ah, it's burnt! Who was watching it?
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.guest.0: You sit at our fire, %s, you eat from it.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.guest.1: Here, %s. There's enough to go round.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.guest.2: Take it, %s. Nobody goes hungry at this fire.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.scraps.0: Here. Don't say we never fed you.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.hungry.0: Nothing left to roast. We'll hunt tomorrow.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.fire.stranger.2: That's no friend of ours, %s. Up!
